_about: The Cozy Café decor set (see GameData.decor_catalogue and design/decor/README.md). One row per item. An item shows up in the game once its model is in design/decor/<id>.glb (made in Meshy from the concept picture <id>.png); until then it waits here, unseen. lie_flat: the model was made standing up (a rug) and is laid down. Wall items are squashed to their depth, however deep the model is. kind: floor or wall. size: [width, depth] on the floor in meters (floor items fill whole 0.5 m squares); height: meters tall (the model is scaled to fit width, height and depth). tier: stars needed before the shop sells it. points: toward the Decor part of the star rating. NAMES, DESCRIPTIONS AND PRICES ARE PLACEHOLDERS to rewrite and tune.
